pkg.lyricsBlock:
[Whispered Narration Intro]
(soft sogeum airy breath, distant gayageum harmonics and warm ajaeng drone, signature hook melody softly introduced)

때로는 아프고 힘든 날에도
너의 미소로 나는 버텨왔어
작은 말 한마디, 따뜻한 손길 feel your warmth

[Verse 1]
(low ajaeng sustained notes with gentle gayageum plucks, subtle janggu rhythm building intimacy)

흩어지는 바람 속에서도
너의 향기가 나를 감싸네 hold me close
넓은 가슴으로 사랑할게

[Pre-Chorus]
(gayageum arpeggio rising, ajaeng glissando adding emotion, percussion layering slowly, taepyeongso warm tease)

너의 모든 걸 다 안아줄게
흔들린 날에도 변치 않는 맘

[BUILD]
(janggu & buk rolls increasing density, ajaeng pitch rising, deep sub bass rumble growing, sogeum soft ornamentation building tension)

[DROP]
(silence 0.6sec → immediate heavy punch: deep sub bass + janggu/buk powerful hit, taepyeongso lead dominates with soaring emotional melody, gayageum rhythm cutting through)

넓은 가슴으로 사랑할게
너의 상처도 다 품어줄게
어두운 밤에도 light your way
나의 사랑으로 널 비출게 forever

[Chorus]
(full traditional fusion groove, bright female vocal with tender emotion, male deep low harmony anchoring strongly)

넓은 가슴으로 사랑할게
너의 상처도 다 품어줄게
어두운 밤에도 꺼지지 않을
나의 사랑으로 널 비출게

[Verse 2]
(softer ajaeng long tones, gayageum delicate strums, male low vocal adding depth and reassurance)

때로는 서로가 지쳐 울 때도
조용히 곁에서 너를 안을게 stay with me
아무 말 없어도 느낄 수 있는 우리만의 깊은 온기

[Rap Break]
(male deep aggressive rhythmic rap, driving janggu & buk with afrobeat groove, ajaeng low warm stabs, taepyeongso short emotional motifs)

Yo, even on the hardest days, your smile keeps me strong
Your scent in the wind, wrapping me all night long
Wide chest open, I'll hold every scar you own
Through the dark nights, Joseon soul in the bass tone
Time may flow but this heart won't change
At the end of the world, I'll still call your name

[BUILD 2]
(denser percussion layers, rising taepyeongso wail with trills, full sub bass swell, maximum emotional tension)

[DROP 2]
(immediate heavy impact, taepyeongso lead stronger with soaring melody and trills, full percussion explosion, female bright adlib)

넓은 가슴으로 사랑할게
너의 상처도 다 품어줄게
어두운 밤에도 light your way
나의 사랑으로 널 비출게 forever

[Final Chorus]
(maximum energy, layered male & female vocals, full instrumentation with powerful hook repetition)

넓은 가슴으로 사랑할게
너의 상처도 다 품어줄게
어두운 밤에도 꺼지지 않을
나의 사랑으로 널 비출게
세상 끝에서도 널 지켜줄게
눈물조차도 사랑이 될 테니
우리의 시간, 그 모든 순간이
영원이 되길 바라며

[Outro]
(fade with sogeum soft air, lingering gayageum harmonics and ajaeng warm drone, whispered male "even at the end of the world... I'll hold you")
pkg.sunoStyle:
Korean traditional fusion EDM with afrobeat groove.
Instruments: gayageum, ajaeng, taepyeongso, sogeum, janggu, buk, kkwaenggwari, jing.
Bass: deep sub bass, strong, punchy, clean from kick.
Drums: afrobeat groove + Korean traditional rhythm.
Drop: instant hit after build, bass + Korean percussion dominate. Taepyeongso or ajaeng lead within 0.3 sec. Kkwaenggwari for tension only, jing for resonance.
Vocal: female bright and emotional. male deep, thick, heavy and resonant.
Male rap: aggressive, rhythmic, low-register English rap.
Structure: build → drop → chorus. 100-110 BPM.
Atmosphere: traditional + modern + cinematic Joseon night vibe.
Restrictions: no modern synth lead, no weak bass, no thin vocal, traditional instruments must remain clearly recognizable.
